label: Town of West Windsor
header:
# Town of West Windsor municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 26; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Mark Higgins (Chair), Mark Harley, and John Brodie for West Windsor's three-member board
Town of West Windsor, 2025 Town Report, 'TOWN OFFICES' elected-officers list (with term-expiry years): Mark Harley, Vice Chair (term to 2026); John Brodie (to 2027); Mark Higgins, Chair (to 2028)
Town of West Windsor, official website homepage, '2026 Town Meeting Recap': 'Selectboard - Mark Harley, reelected by voice vote' at the March 2026 meeting

offices.title: Town Moderator
offices.org_name: Town of West Windsor Town Moderator

sources.note: Town of West Windsor, official website homepage, '2026 Town Meeting Recap': 'Article 1 - Moderator, Shelley Seward, elected by voice vote' (2026). She succeeds Matthew Birmingham, whose term expired in 2026 and whose memorial the 2025 Town Report carries

offices.title: Town Clerk
offices.org_name: Town of West Windsor Town Clerk

sources.note: Town of West Windsor, 2025 Town Report: the elected 'TOWN OFFICES' roster omits the clerk, and the report's directory names 'Amy W. Yates, Town Clerk/Treasurer'; the 2026 warning (printed in the report) lists the officers to be elected in its Article 3 and omits the clerk

Town of West Windsor, 2024 Town Report: the warning for the March 2025 meeting likewise omits the clerk from the officers to be elected. Two consecutive warnings plus the roster omission are read as a conversion of the office to appointment under 17 V.S.A. sec. 2651e; Yates is seated as the appointee (call disclosed on #163)

offices.title: Town Treasurer
offices.org_name: Town of West Windsor Town Treasurer

sources.note: Town of West Windsor, 2025 Town Report: the elected roster omits the treasurer; its directory names 'Amy W. Yates, Town Clerk/Treasurer,' and she signs the treasurer's report. Read as a sec. 2651f appointment conversion on the same evidence as the clerkship (disclosed on #163)

offices.title: Auditor
offices.org_name: Town of West Windsor Board of Auditors

sources.note: Town of West Windsor, 2025 Town Report, 'TOWN OFFICES' elected-officers list (with term-expiry years): Auditors -- Justin Burrows (term to 2026); Nancy Gaynor (to 2027); Barbara Gerstner (to 2028)

Town of West Windsor, official website homepage, '2026 Town Meeting Recap': 'Auditor - Justin Burrows, reelected by voice vote' (2026). Gaynor also holds a justice of the peace seat; one record carries both memberships

offices.title: Collector of Delinquent Taxes
offices.org_name: Town of West Windsor Collector of Delinquent Taxes

sources.note: Town of West Windsor, official website homepage, '2026 Town Meeting Recap': 'Delinquent Tax Collector - Amy Yates, reelected by voice vote' (2026) -- this membership is elected, unlike her appointed clerk and treasurer posts

offices.title: First Constable
offices.org_name: Town of West Windsor First Constable

sources.note: Town of West Windsor, official website homepage, '2026 Town Meeting Recap': 'First Constable - Matt Kantola, reelected by voice vote' (2026)

offices.title: Second Constable
offices.org_name: Town of West Windsor Second Constable

sources.note: Town of West Windsor, official website homepage, '2026 Town Meeting Recap': 'Second Constable - Vacant' (2026); Mark Morse held the seat to 2026 per the 2025 Town Report and was not reelected, so the post is created without a membership

offices.title: Town Agent
offices.org_name: Town of West Windsor Town Agent

sources.note: Town of West Windsor, official website homepage, '2026 Town Meeting Recap': 'Town Agent - Vacant' (2026) -- the office was warned as a one-year elective office in 2025; the post is created without a membership

offices.title: Trustee of Campbell Fund
offices.org_name: Town of West Windsor Campbell Fund Trustees

sources.note: Town of West Windsor, 2025 Town Report, 'TOWN OFFICES' elected-officers list (with term-expiry years): Campbell Fund Trustees -- Patricia Kenyon (term to 2026); Jennifer Hastings Tobias (to 2027); Betty French (to 2028)
Town of West Windsor, official website homepage, '2026 Town Meeting Recap': 'Campbell Fund Trustee - Patricia Kenyon, reelected by voice vote' (2026)

offices.title: Justice of the Peace
offices.org_name: Town of West Windsor Justices of the Peace

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five West Windsor justices of the peace: Margaret Clough, Nancy Gaynor, Debra Shearer, Debra Bullock Spackman, and Anne P. Yates; the town report's short forms (Deb Shearer, Deb Spackman, Anne Yates) yield to the certified forms. Anne Yates is a different person from Amy Yates the clerk/treasurer

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): certifies the five winners of West Windsor's November 5, 2024 justice of the peace election (vote for five): Margaret Clough, Nancy Gaynor, Debra Shearer, Debra Bullock Spackman, and Anne P. Yates
